title: Persistence and Change in National Production Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many country-years in multi-country input-output databases have no national table. We study the kernel of domestic intermediate transactions, the part that rescaling to new industry totals cannot update. Among 25 economies with a national table every year, the latest table misplaces 6.6 percent of the kernel one year ahead and 21.2 percent ten years ahead, while the five most similar economies misplace 24.1 to 25.0 percent at every horizon. In the OECD tables, 88 percent of country-years without a national table lie close to one cross-country template, against 3.6 percent of country-years with a table. The template spreads from 29 economies in 2019 to 67 in 2022. In this sample an own table's error meets its distance to that year's template near fifteen years, not as a general shelf life.

translated_title: 国民生产网络的持久性与变化
translated_abstract: 在多国投入产出数据库中，许多国家-年份缺少本国投入产出表。我们研究了国内中间交易的“核”，即通过重新标度到新的产业总量也无法更新的部分。在25个每年都拥有本国表的经济体中，最新的本国表在预测一年后会错置核中6.6%的流量，十年后则错置21.2%，而五个最相似的经济体在任何时间跨度上都会错置24.1%至25.0%。在OECD的表中，88%没有本国表的国家-年份接近于同一个跨国模板，而拥有本国表的国家-年份中这一比例仅为3.6%。该模板覆盖的经济体从2019年的29个扩展到2022年的67个。在本样本中，本国表的误差约在十五年后才与该年份跨国模板的距离相当，但这并非一个普遍适用的“保质期”。
tldr: 该论文通过量化投入产出数据库中“核”的错置程度，揭示本国表在短期内（一年仅错置6.6%）远优于跨国相似性插补，而大量缺失本国表的国家-年份实际上趋同于一个不断扩散的跨国模板。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the misplacement of the kernel in input-output databases, showing that a country's own national table is far superior to cross-country imputation in the short run (only 6.6% misplaced one year ahead), while most country-years lacking national tables actually converge to a spreading cross-country template.
